Class WordsTest

java.lang.Object
it.unipd.nonsense.utils.WordsTest
public class WordsTest extends Object
Test class for the abstract Words base class. Verifies common dictionary functionality including: - Dictionary loading from files - Random word generation - Edge case handling - Error conditions Uses a test subclass of Words to test the abstract base class functionality.
